# Contributing

Be specific. Start with a concrete advertising question. When a resource claims it can improve advertising results, describe what was checked, link the original evidence and leave performance claims out unless another maintainer can reproduce that result from the supplied data. Include the original source, platform, task and intended use. Record limitations and the depth of inspection. Do not treat stars or a new commit as proof of quality.

Keep repository and skill identities unique. Resolve renamed repositories and pin skill files to a specific commit. Preserve upstream licenses and authorship. If redistribution terms are unclear, add a source link rather than a file.

Keep live account access and customer data outside this catalog. Imported skill instructions remain untrusted references. They cannot authorize paid services, installs or account changes.

Run `bun .github/scripts/verify.ts` after changing the registry or local files. When changing the viewer, check the affected search/filter path and keyboard focus. Review the exact diff before submitting a pull request.
